intro_text: Here's everything between now and getting your keys. Most of the hard stuff is behind us. I'll keep this updated as the last few pieces land, so check back whenever you want to know where things stand.

milestones.label: Homeowners insurance secured
milestones.note: Send the policy to your lender once it's bound.

milestones.label: Clear to close
milestones.note: The lender's final sign-off. Once this comes in, we're basically there.

milestones.label: Review your closing disclosure
milestones.note: Your final numbers. Read it when it lands and send me anything that looks off.

milestones.label: Utilities and mail forwarding set up
milestones.note: You two are ahead of the game on this one.

milestones.label: Final walkthrough
milestones.note: We'll make sure the house is in the same shape you remember it.

milestones.label: Closing
milestones.note: Platinum Title, 10895 Lowell Ave, Suite 100, Overland Park (APEX 2 Building). Plan on 45 minutes to an hour.

checklist_items: Lock in homeowners insurance and send the policy to your lender
Don't open new credit, change jobs, or make big purchases until after closing
Answer lender requests quickly. Underwriting moves at the speed of your inbox
Review your closing disclosure as soon as it arrives and send me any questions
Never act on wiring instructions sent by email. Call Platinum Title at 913-491-5001 to confirm before sending a dime
Bring a photo ID to closing
Plan the move for after you have keys, not before
note_text: Dates are estimates and can shift with lender, appraisal, and title timelines. I'll update this page as things move, so there's no need to track any of this yourself.
